reviews.text: Thanks to Carlos, a true professional! He's been very attentive to all of Mia's work and very involved and attentive to her progress! Thank you so much, Carlos, you're a great professional!
Coach Edu is excellent. We saw results from the very first class. Highly recommended.
Our experience with Anastasia has been very good! Our dogs have improved and we are very grateful!

Anastasia has been a huge help with our mischievous greyhound, Nemo. Thanks to her training, he's now much calmer on walks and responds better when called. He's also gotten quite used to being in his bed (his "calm zone"), and we've learned that dogs need boundaries too, no matter how much you love them. Thank you, Anastasia!

Paula's classes have been incredibly helpful. They've really helped me understand what Pepo needs to better manage his frustration. Now it's time to put what I've learned into practice and keep improving little by little. Asking for help when you feel you don't have all the tools to train your dog is so important and absolutely necessary, and more people should consider it.

Thank you so much for everything!
Everything is great with Carlos; we noticed changes in our little one from day one.

Our experience with Noblekan has been very positive, especially thanks to Rubén, our trainer, with whom we've worked since Cooper was just two and a half months old.

Rubén is a true professional, very approachable, patient, responsible, and always willing to listen to our needs and adapt to them. From the beginning, he came to our home to get to know our environment, our routine, and Cooper's relationship with our cat, and he has been with us through all the stages of his development.

What I value most is that he doesn't just teach exercises, but also explains canine behavior and psychology, helping us to better understand Cooper and work with him effectively.

My contact with Noblekan as a company has been quite limited, since practically all of our experience has been directly with Rubén, but I'm very grateful that they put us in touch with him.

Thank you so much, Rubén, for your dedication, patience, and for everything you've taught us! Cooper and I are thrilled. 😊

We have a five-year-old boxer who had many anxiety attacks, especially at night, which could last up to an hour or two. It was awful for both her and me. We contacted Noblecan and they assigned us Ruben as our trainer 😊. The experience has been wonderful. From the very first day, Thai showed improvement, and now she's like a completely different dog. She's calm and hasn't had any more anxiety attacks. When night comes, she behaves normally, goes to her bed, and seems like a different dog. I'm so, so happy and incredibly grateful to Ruben for all the work he's done with us, with our dog, and with me 😅 💪🏽🐶❤️
Paula was very professional and patiently resolved all the problems I had with my dog. Thank you very much.
Jose Luis and Juan Antonio are excellent professionals. In just a few sessions, our dog has made a complete turnaround for the better. I highly recommend them.

We want to sincerely thank Paula for everything she has done for our dog, Nudo. From the very first moment, she has demonstrated tremendous professionalism, patience, and above all, incredible affection for him.

She has taught us so much and helped us better understand his behavior and how to act in every situation. She also explains everything very clearly and simply, making it easy to put her advice into practice every day.

Something we especially appreciate is how attentive she has been to Nudo throughout the entire process, worrying about his progress and supporting us every step of the way. It's clear she enjoys her work and that she truly cares about the well-being of dogs.

We are so grateful for everything she has taught us and for the trust she has instilled in us during this process. We would definitely recommend Paula to anyone who needs help with their dog.

Thank you for everything, Paula, and for treating Nudo with so much love.

We will continue to count on you for anything we need. ❤️🐶

Our dog Choc used to bark at the children, at guests who came to the house, at the doorbell, and he would pull on the leash. Thanks to trainer Ramón, in just two classes (two weeks) we corrected everything and understood what we were doing wrong. Now Choc behaves much better, and walks with him are no longer a constant source of tension. Many thanks to Ramón for helping us through this process; he was incredibly kind and explained everything perfectly. 🥰🥳🥳

Highly professional, excellent service. We followed all the instructions Brujo gave us, and the results couldn't be better. We give them a 10 out of 10. Thank you to Jose Luis and Juan Antonio for your masterclasses. We won't hesitate to call you again if we need your services. We recommend you 100%.

I couldn't have asked for a better trainer, Paula. Thank you so much; the transformation in Lima has been incredible. Choosing Noblecan and finding Paula was absolutely the right decision. Above all, I appreciated her commitment to transparency. The dog training process can drag on indefinitely because owners never know how long their dog needs to keep learning, but Paula said, "That's it, now the ongoing work is yours as the owner." I'm thrilled and will definitely recommend Noblecan and Paula to everyone.

I really enjoyed it.
You learn things about your dog that you didn't know. Very professional.

Paula is helping us with our puppy, and she's amazing! She knows so much about dogs and how to correct our behavior with the dog before the puppy's. She's training us on how to behave with the dog so we can make him more well-balanced, and we're succeeding!

I 100% recommend her!!

It has been a great experience with changes from the very first session. Zeus is a Weimaraner puppy with a lot of energy and very high energy spikes, and Debora knew how to guide him from the first moment, demonstrating extensive knowledge about our furry friends. Without a doubt, a more than satisfactory experience. Thank you, Debora, for so much patience.

We trained Balto with Judith, and we truly owe her a great deal. Balto had separation anxiety and pulled a lot on walks, and thanks to all her guidance, we've managed to reduce those behaviors almost completely! Many thanks to Judith and the entire team behind her, who also provided support through the WhatsApp group whenever we needed it.

After 3 sessions (6 classes in total) with Débora, our puppy Whisky has improved tremendously. 🐶❤️

He's stopped having accidents in the house, he's learned to wait, to be more patient with us, and above all, he's started to understand the rules and boundaries he needs to follow in his little world.

Also, because of my partner's work schedule, we always had to schedule the classes quite late, from 8:00 to 9:30 pm. We want to especially thank Débora for adapting to our schedules and dedicating some of her personal time to help us. We really appreciate it.

We are very happy with the results and believe that training at this puppy stage is a very, very important investment for having a balanced, well-behaved, and happy dog ​​in the future.

Thank you so much, Débora, for your patience, dedication, and help with Whisky! And thank you also to the entire NobleCan team. ❤️🐾

We worked with Juanan and our dog Aldo just five days after our daughter was born. We were worried because the dog was barking and growling at her. In just one session, Juanan provided us with guidance and strategies to calm the dog, which we put into practice and they worked immediately. Now the dog shares space with the baby calmly and we are all happy. Definitely a great decision. Thank you so much, Juanan and NobleCan!
Juan did a fantastic job; it's clear he knows a lot about dogs, especially our dog's breed, and his advice was effective from the very first lesson. I highly recommend him.

Paula was a huge help to our dog who had separation anxiety. He's made a huge difference. We would definitely recommend Noblecan to any owner who has concerns about their dog's behavior. Eternally grateful!

We were under the tutelage of Paula, a fantastic trainer. Yango couldn't be left alone; even a shower would take a while before he'd have accidents in the house. We couldn't leave his side for a second. Thanks to Paula's training, we can now live peacefully and return to our normal lives. An unbeatable experience.

Ruben has been our trainer, and from the very first day we noticed a big change. He gave us lots of advice and many exercises to do with them at home, and that's how we've seen the progress. We're very grateful to him and for everything we've learned.
Ruben provided excellent service, was very nice, and did a great job with my reactive dog.

Anastasia, the trainer, has helped me tremendously in my relationship with my dog, and I've learned to set boundaries. She was always attentive, asking how I was progressing with the training and answering my questions. Overall, a great experience.
Thanks for the review! 🥰🎓 …
Paula is great at training not only our puppy but also teaching us, her caregivers, the best way to develop long-term skills and behaviors!
We loved the class you gave us at home. It was very helpful and helped us understand my dog ​​Hana's needs. Thank you for your help.
Thank you so much for the review! 🐾🎓 …

Paula knew exactly what we needed to work on with Bella.
She's a true professional who understands people, but especially animals.
We followed all the guidelines, and Bella has made a radical difference.
100% recommended. Paula is also very empathetic; she listens to you and to them, which is ultimately the most important thing.
Thank you for everything, Paula. We were so glad we chose you! 😊

My dog ​​and I are thrilled with Paula's training sessions. We learned simple guidelines and exercises to help her be calmer and more obedient, both at home and outdoors. After each session, we were given homework to help us stay consistent (essential!). Although we still have a lot of work and practice ahead of us, we saw improvements right away, from the very first days.
I would recommend Paula 100%! She's very patient and very affectionate with dogs.

(Note: Although the service is a bit pricey, it was worth it for us!)

Débora is a fantastic trainer. She's given us tons of amazing tips to better understand our dog and know how to handle different everyday situations. She's helped us tremendously to improve our relationship and, above all, to understand why he does certain things and how we can teach him respectfully and effectively.

Plus, she's incredibly friendly, patient, and you can tell she's passionate about what she does. She always gives us practical solutions tailored to our dog, and we leave each session with tools we can actually use at home.

We're so glad we had her and highly recommend her. ❤️

The experience has been wonderful. Débora knew exactly what to guide us on every step of the way. From day one, she gave us advice tailored to our needs, and above all, accessible and achievable—realistic aspects to address daily that allowed us to improve, things we could start doing right away. She guided the training based on our very specific personal needs. We've observed a substantial and very noticeable change in our dog's behavior, and this is undoubtedly all thanks to her. If we ever need to, we would definitely repeat the experience. Thank you so much.

A fantastic experience with Lia's classes. Enzo has completely changed; her explanations were very clear and the exercises easy to do. I'll definitely keep her in mind for any situation with my puppy.

We contacted Noblecan for help with our newly adopted greyhound, because we wanted them to help us train her to come and go when called and feel comfortable with us. And then Lia (the trainer) came into our lives… to whom we will be eternally grateful for everything she has achieved with our dog, Canela. She now roams freely in the countryside and is always looking out for us. We want to thank her for who she is, her attentiveness, her great work, and her love for animals. We have nothing but praise for her. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts. We would definitely use your services again, and especially Lia's.

Excellent dog training. When I adopted my dog ​​Fausto, I knew I was going to need help... and without Paula, we wouldn't have made it. A true professional with extensive knowledge, she is caring and empathetic not only with the dog but also with the human. I think we make a perfect team, and we continue working on Fausto's reintegration into a normal dog life. THANK YOU

Our experience with Lia has been very positive, as working with our dog Oreo was quite complicated, and her professionalism was evident from the very beginning. He has completely changed, and we are extremely grateful. Many thanks to Lia for giving us such challenging lessons and for having the patience we needed :)

Excellent experience with very good results in both the short and medium term. We will continue working at home with the tools the educator provided. We were very satisfied with Débora; her instructions were clear and she was very pleasant to work with. Highly recommended.

Juanan's work with Suko has been very important to us. I congratulate him because he has been a great help. Suko is calmer now, and we hope that our future together will have the same positive outcome. Thank you so much for everything.
